version.description: etcd version (X.Y.Z) to run, set on the EtcdCluster's spec.version; the operator pulls etcd from its own configured image.

storageClass.description: StorageClass used to store the data.

resources.description: Resource configuration for etcd: `cpu` and `memory` are the limits, the requests follow the platform's allocation ratios. Empty, the chart picks a size by tier: the platform's shared datastore in tenant-root keeps 1000m and 512Mi, while a tenant's own etcd, which serves that tenant's clusters alone, starts from 100m and 128Mi requested with 1000m and 512Mi limited.

affinity.description: Affinity rules set verbatim on the EtcdCluster's spec.affinity, replacing the chart default. When left empty the chart applies a soft (preferred) podAntiAffinity that spreads members across nodes by kubernetes.io/hostname on a best-effort basis, so a single node failure is less likely to take out more than one member. The default is intentionally soft: a hard rule would leave a member Pending when there are fewer schedulable nodes than replicas, or when node-local storage pins a member to a node. Set a hard requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution rule here to forbid co-location outright (only on clusters with enough nodes and non-node-pinned storage). Note that the operator applies affinity only when it creates or replaces a member Pod and does not reschedule running members, so on a cluster that already has co-located members the rule takes effect only as each member is replaced, not retroactively.
